result.summary: A pedestrian signal and push button are situated on a narrow, degraded concrete path adjacent to a tall sound wall. The environment lacks adequate separation from the roadway and is cluttered with debris, suggesting a low-priority area for pedestrian comfort and safety.

hazards.name: Narrow Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: The walking area is extremely narrow, forcing pedestrians to stand very close to the roadway edge line.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom right of the image along the concrete strip

hazards.name: Surface Debris and Degradation
hazards.description: Accumulated trash, gravel, and cracked pavement create tripping hazards and indicate poor maintenance.
hazards.location_in_image: Ground level near the base of the signal pole

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Expand the pedestrian walkway and provide a physical buffer or green strip between the path and the travel lanes to increase separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Routine Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly clear debris and repair the pavement surface to ensure a safe and accessible walking environment.

result.summary: The intersection is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being a signalized junction. The environment is dominated by industrial land use and heavy vehicle traffic, with a sidewalk present on only one side of the street.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible, meaning walkers have no indication of when it is safe to cross relative to vehicle traffic phases.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles

hazards.name: Heavy Vehicle Traffic
hazards.description: The presence of large semi-trucks increases the risk of severe injury and creates significant blind spots for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, a large white truck is entering the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, which can create tripping hazards or cause vehicles to swerve.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve compliance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the roadway to provide a continuous and safe walking path.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and compliant curb ramps at all intersection corners.

result.summary: The environment is a high-traffic industrial zone with significant heavy vehicle presence and a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk is present on one side, the absence of marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps creates a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large semi-trucks parked near the intersection block visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left background near the industrial entrance

hazards.name: Missing Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection forces pedestrians to cross without guidance or protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear in the asphalt can create tripping hazards and uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to provide accessible transitions from the sidewalk to the street.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, lacking basic infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings along a multi-lane arterial. The presence of a large concrete wall and poor pavement conditions further exacerbate the risks for anyone attempting to navigate this area on foot.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to walk on the road shoulder or uneven dirt strip.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the concrete wall.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Quality
hazards.description: The road surface is heavily cracked and patched, creating trip hazards and uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible roadway surface.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible at this intersection, making crossing extremely dangerous.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the foreground.
